# Each write of each act, refused one at a time on a fresh page. A block: the write and the
# answer; the requests that followed it; each run of text that appeared on the page (container,
# innermost element); the sheet; the page's message state; any rejection the page left unhandled.

## Edit Screen A (the note)
# writes, in order: PUT /api/operator-stations/11
### PUT /api/operator-stations/11  ←  400 {"error"} (writeError)
    then: nothing
    new text: .layer-scrim span.layer-status.is-bad: the Edge refused it
    sheet: open "Edit Screen A", status "the Edge refused it" (bad), OK "Save" enabled
    state: no message set
    unhandled rejection: none
    pressed again: PUT /api/operator-stations/11 · GET /api/operator-stations · GET /api/operator-stations/11/claimed-nodes · GET /api/processes · GET /api/processes/1/composer?map_rev=map-r1 · GET /api/processes/1/styles · POST /api/processes/1/flow/preview → sheet: closed
### PUT /api/operator-stations/11  ←  500, no body (chi Recoverer)
    then: nothing
    new text: .layer-scrim span.layer-status.is-bad: Server error (500)
    sheet: open "Edit Screen A", status "Server error (500)" (bad), OK "Save" enabled
    state: no message set
    unhandled rejection: none
    pressed again: PUT /api/operator-stations/11 · GET /api/operator-stations · GET /api/operator-stations/11/claimed-nodes · GET /api/processes · GET /api/processes/1/composer?map_rev=map-r1 · GET /api/processes/1/styles · POST /api/processes/1/flow/preview → sheet: closed
### PUT /api/operator-stations/11  ←  no answer (fetch rejects: TypeError "Failed to fetch")
    then: nothing
    new text: .layer-scrim span.layer-status.is-bad: No answer from the server
    sheet: open "Edit Screen A", status "No answer from the server" (bad), OK "Save" enabled
    state: no message set
    unhandled rejection: none
    pressed again: PUT /api/operator-stations/11 · GET /api/operator-stations · GET /api/operator-stations/11/claimed-nodes · GET /api/processes · GET /api/processes/1/composer?map_rev=map-r1 · GET /api/processes/1/styles · POST /api/processes/1/flow/preview → sheet: closed
### PUT /api/operator-stations/11  ←  session lapsed (303 to /login, 200 text/html, for it and every admin call after)
    then: nothing
    new text: .notice-root span.notice-text: Signed out
    new text: .notice-root a.notice-action: Sign in
    notice: error "Signed out" (sticky) · Sign in → /login?next=%2Fprocesses%3Fprocess%3D1
    sheet: open "Edit Screen A", no status, OK "Save" enabled
    state: no message set
    unhandled rejection: none
    pressed again: PUT /api/operator-stations/11 → sheet: open "Edit Screen A", no status, OK "Save" enabled
